answer: Proof-of-stake protocols enforce Sybil resistance by requiring capital commitment, creating a steep ridge of economic exclusion for attackers. Just as a canyon separates distinct terrains, stake requirements isolate malicious actors by mandating verifiable assets. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces a juniper of prohibitive costs, as partitioning resources across numerous nodes dilutes their voting power while multiplying the capital necessary to influence the consensus.
